newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi riyal deposit rates rise, spot eases.
newsitem.headline: Saudi riyal deposit rates rise, spot eases.

text.p: The spot Saudi riyal eased on the dollar as banks bought dollars to cover positions ahead of the first-quarter end, but riyal interbank deposit rates rose around 1/16 in line with higher U.S. rates, dealers said.
They said the spot riyal value March 31 eased to 3.7510/13 to the dollar from 3.7504/06 last week, but the riyal value April 1 was unchanged at 3.7504/06.
"Banks are buying dollars to cover their short positions," one Riyadh-based dealer said.
Most interbank deposit rates climbed 1/16 point.
One-month rates were put at 5-11/16, 9/16 percent, three months 5-13/16 11/16 percent, six months at six, 5-7/8 percent and one-year maturities were quoted at 6-5/16, 3/16 percent.
